interpretation: All-population observed coverage uses the frozen eligible denominator. Untested, ambiguous, authentication, rate-limit, and network outcomes remain unresolved; no unresolved outcome is a confirmed indexing miss. Announcement-date cohorts do not measure exact latency.

populationValidation.note: The final Chromium-produced freeze was checked to contain exactly the same ordered IDs, versions, categories, primary categories, announcement dates, and section labels as the initial production-parser freeze used to submit these queries. Analysis was recomputed offline against the final archived freeze. No provider requests were repeated.

attribution.note: Raw OpenAIRE responses are public Graph records with attribution. arXiv source pages retain their existing notices. No credentials or personal feedback/reading data are included.
